categories.main_business_segments: Dalipal Holdings Limited primarily engages in the research and development, production, technical services, and sales of high-end energy pipes and special seamless steel pipes. Their products serve the oil, natural gas, shale gas, and new energy sectors, including energy development, mining, transportation, and energy equipment manufacturing. The company also produces high-end energy equipment components for wind power, nuclear power, hydropower, and petrochemical industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including intelligent manufacturing equipment, full-process material tracking systems, digitalized testing equipment, and process modeling systems to ensure optimal production. They focus on green and low-carbon product development, employing technologies such as low-nitrogen combustion, adsorption and catalytic combustion for emissions control, and energy-saving retrofits. Their production methods emphasize lean management, intelligent automation, and high-precision mechanical pipe rolling, supported by collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dalipal serves well-known domestic and international oil companies, petrochemical firms, mechanical processing and manufacturing enterprises, geological exploration, and coal mining companies. Their products are widely used in major oil and gas fields across China and exported to over 70 countries and regions worldwide, including markets in the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hong Kong and principal business locations in Hebei Province, PRC. It has expanded internationally with a strategic development plan in the Middle East, establishing production facilities in Saudi Arabia, including a partnership with Saudi Aramco’s subsidiary SPARK. Overseas sales cover multiple regions but have recently declined due to global economic factors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dalipal operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying specialized steel pipes and components for energy industries. They maintain control over the full industrial chain from raw material procurement (scrap steel and alloys) through production to sales and technical services, emphasizing integration and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include high-end product development, intelligent manufacturing, green and low-carbon technologies, and lean management. R&D focuses on corrosion-resistant materials, high-strength steel casings, hydrogen storage pipeline steel, and special-thread petroleum pipes. They actively pursue innovation through partnerships with universities and research institutes and emphasize ESG integration and sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Dalipal generates revenue primarily through the sale of oil and gas pipes, new energy pipes, and special seamless steel pipes. Their business model is sales-driven production with a combination of market and self-pricing strategies. They also receive government grants and by-product income, and their revenue is derived from both domestic and international sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading high-tech and high-end manufacturer in the specialized steel pipe industry, recognized as a national high-tech and intellectual property advantage enterprise. It competes by focusing on differentiated specialty products, technological innovation, and intelligent manufacturing. Dalipal has received industry certifications and awards, enhancing its competitive standing against other large enterprises and smaller competitors in the sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Dalipal recorded revenue of RMB3.29 billion, a 14.5% decrease from 2023, with a net loss of RMB77.1 million compared to a profit in the prior year. The company invested RMB327.6 million in capital expenditure, mainly for Phase Two Expansion. Despite recent losses, the company is cautiously optimistic about recovery and growth, supported by strategic international expansion and product upgrades. The Group employs approximately 1,795 employees and maintains a debt-to-equity ratio of 136.9%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dalipal emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced, and environmentally friendly products with strong corrosion resistance, high strength, and specialized features tailored for harsh energy industry conditions. Their intelligent manufacturing and green production processes ensure product consistency and sustainability. The company’s differentiated product portfolio, including unique non-API specialty pipes and innovative materials, combined with strong R&D and ESG commitments, provide competitive advantages and create value for global customers.
